mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 59 degrees and a lovely New Moon phase tonight.

Regarding city news, residents should be aware of a recent police incident from September 10th involving a burglary and weapons offence on Hunter's Cove Way, as well as upcoming notice information regarding the general election on November 3rd.
We have plenty to do this weekend with the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow and various trivia nights starting Monday.
In our weekly report, we are highlighting an incident from September 10th where officers apprehended a suspect for burglary and a weapons offence after responding to a call on Hunter's Cove Way.
Today at Culver's of Verona, the flavor of the day is Really Reese's. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
